title: World Weave
tagline: Weave real heritage patterns, one tile at a time.
description: World Weave is a calm tile-placement puzzle built from real heritage patterns. Rotate and flip each tile so its edges continue whatever is already placed, then drop it into an open cell - nothing is ever blocked. Every region shares one weave-fit mechanic and adds a single construction-rule twist: a locking rosette (Mesopotamia), an unbroken kolam thread (Deccan & South India), or a backward color-run (Niger River & West Africa). Fill a panel to reveal real heritage notes, and match its twist for a "perfect weave." The World Atlas tracks your mastery as more civilizations are added.
howToPlay: Tap Rotate or Flip to line up the active tile's edges with what's already on the board.
Tap an open cell to drop the tile - nothing is ever blocked, so you can always keep playing.
A strong edge match glows and chimes; a weak one just looks and sounds duller.
Chain good placements for a streak, and watch heritage notes reveal at 25%, 50% and 75% filled.
Each region adds one twist to learn: a locking rosette, an unbroken thread, or a backward color-run.
Match every twist across a full panel for a "perfect weave" and unlock a deeper heritage fact.
Tap Undo for a free take-back - except a locked rosette cell, which stays locked for good.
Open World Atlas from the title screen to track your mastery across every region.
